title: Shadownet Integration Bundle
description: Response body of GET <base>/v1/account/me/integration-bundle. See RFC-0008.

did.description: Tenant DID. did:key for individuals, did:web for organizations (RFC-0002).

protected_resource_metadata.description: RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata URL for this tenant's MCP endpoint. MUST be present iff `oauth-authorize` is in `supported_features` (RFC-0009).

webhook_secret.description: Pre-provisioned HMAC secret, or null if no subscriber is registered.

supported_features.description: Capability flags. RFC-0008 § Capability flags defines the v0.1 set; clients tolerate unknown future values.

version.description: Sidecar implementation version (free-form, semver RECOMMENDED). Not the protocol version.
